data: What is the model architecture used in this experiment, and how does it influence the results?

The figure shows the effect of the dropout rate during training on the F1-Multi score. The lines represent different dropout rates for both training and validation data. The legend indicates the following:

- Blue line: Train-0.7 (dropout rate of 0.7)
- Orange line: Train-0.3 (dropout rate of 0.3)
- Green line: Train-0.1 (dropout rate of 0.1)
- Dashed red line: Valid-0.7 (dropout rate of 0.7)
- Dotted purple line: Valid-0.3 (dropout rate of 0.3)
- Dashed brown line: Valid-0.1 (dropout rate of 0.1)

From the figure, we can observe that the higher the dropout rate during training, the lower the F1-Multi score. This suggests that a lower dropout rate during training may lead to better generalization performance, as indicated by the higher F1-Multi scores for the lower dropout rates in the validation data.
